name: perch-audio
description: Microphone capture and, on a machine with a GPU, speech-to-text for Perch dictation. Runs on your local machine, so it works when the workspace is remote.

perchAudio.device.description: The microphone to record from, by name. Empty uses the system default. Choose one with Perch Audio: Choose Microphone.

perchAudio.maxSeconds.description: Recording stops by itself after this many seconds.

perchAudio.saveRecordings.description: A diagnostic. A directory on this computer; each recording is saved there as a WAV, with a transcripts.log of what was heard when the words are worked out here. Empty saves nothing.
